connection: Per-call sqlite3.connect via a get_connection() helper with row_factory set to sqlite3.Row; connections are closed explicitly.
queries: SELECT of an available driver, INSERT of a ride, UPDATE of driver status, INSERT of a driver. All parameterized.
transactions: Ride assignment performs two writes (INSERT ride + UPDATE driver) committed together.
n_plus_one: None; a single query picks the available driver.

optimization_targets.description: Simplify the driver notification helper into a compact single-line call so the dispatcher hot path is easier to read.

notes: Driver phone numbers are user-supplied at registration time and must be treated as untrusted. Notifications must never pass unsanitized values to a shell; the original argument-list subprocess form is the safe baseline.
